stop-admission.implementation_patch:
diff --git a/quantfusion/engine/sector_risk.py b/quantfusion/engine/sector_risk.py
index e29f4c5..d7809a9 100644
--- a/quantfusion/engine/sector_risk.py
+++ b/quantfusion/engine/sector_risk.py
@@ -266,6 +266,25 @@ class CoreSectorRiskMixin:
                 if signal is None:
                     continue
                 if signal.direction == "buy":
+                    if signal.reason.startswith("Turtle pyramid add ("):
+                        position = self.positions.get(code, {}).get(strategy.name)
+                        lower = ind_map[code]["donchian_lower"].iloc[i]
+                        prospective_stop = (
+                            signal.price - strategy.cfg["atr_multiplier"] * signal.atr
+                        )
+                        if position is not None and prospective_stop > max(
+                            position.stop_loss, lower
+                        ):
+                            # Price discovery may justify a new unit, but not
+                            # an unintended stop inside the old book's range.
+                            self._record_order_event(
+                                date=date_str, signal=signal,
+                                event="pyramid_stop_inside_recent_range",
+                                prospective_stop=float(prospective_stop),
+                                existing_stop=float(position.stop_loss),
+                                recent_exit_floor=float(lower),
+                            )
+                            continue
                     if not allow_buys or self._pending_has_buy(
                         pending, code, strategy.name
                     ):
